prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location review concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Chunky hard square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained three-tone stone timber linen iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painting or photorealism. No people, no readable text, no quest UI, no magic, no claimed outcome. Modest practical scale, no giant fantasy architecture. Open ordinary return path clearly visible. Geometry is a proposal, not certified collision or inventory. A modest cooper apprentice's temporary work shed with its OWN open rear-street entrance, separate from master's larger workshop visible only as distant closed wall. Small portable personal tool roll with a drawknife, mallet and small chisel; a FEW wage tally sticks on shallow tray, one unfinished barrel hoop and limited timber offcuts on bench. Empty stool, free exit. No beer brewing or winemaker instruments, no worker present, no forced departure, settled future wages, erased authorship mark or abundant orders. A neutral workspace proposal, not proof tools/payment/independence were delivered.
